review_evidence: Toric/GroupScheme/Character.lean, Diagonalizable.lean, MonoidAlgebra.lean, and Torus.lean implement the core group-scheme development.
Toric/ToricVariety/Defs.lean, FromMonoid.lean, ToricIdeal.lean, and the SO2/character-cocharacter examples provide reusable definitions and examples.
Toric/Imports.lean and small Mathlib support modules are dependency/interface glue for the formal library, not provably lossless hard-exclusion targets.
summary: Reviewed the complete toric unit. Its primary files form a coherent toric/group-scheme/Hopf-algebra development; even small import/support modules participate in that formal interface and remain searchable.
